thread:
Jordan (Support): @Lucy sorry to hear that — can you paste the invoice id and the date range you saw the spike?
Lucy (Acme Prod): INV-2026-09-003. We got charged an extra $4,120 for Mar 3-10 window, expected ~ $300.
Jordan (Support): Yikes. Did you do a tenant migration or org rekey around Mar 5?
Lucy (Acme Prod): Yes — migrated to the new org_id at 2026-03-05 03:12 UTC. Dashboard shows a small spike, but nothing that big and no obvious duplicate requests on our side.
Maya (Eng Oncall): I'll pull metering events for that tenant range and check ingestion logs now.
billing-bot: provisional credit $4,120 issued (ticket B-8392) :white_check_mark: — note: credit pending reconciliation.
Sam (Finance): Please don't finalize until engineering confirms root cause. We need a short revrec note for month-end if the credit stands.
Maya (Eng Oncall): Quick update — I see duplicated ingestion events from the migration job. For ~8 minutes after the migration (03:12–03:20 UTC) the migration orchestrator replayed webhook deliveries and metering events were recorded 3x for many sequences.
Jordan (Support): Does that align with the delta on the invoice?
Maya (Eng Oncall): Yes, counts line up. Sample sequence ids: `seq_83af`, `seq_83af` (x3), `seq_9c10` (x3). Meter worker logs: `WARN metering: replay detected but dedupe_window=0 (migration_mode)` — dedupe was disabled by the migration flag.
metering-worker: "ERROR: migration flag bypassed dedupe; wrote duplicate usage events to ledger"
Maya (Eng Oncall): Pushed a hotfix to honor the dedupe header even during migrations and backfilled a filter to drop duplicates for the affected time window. Generating export of affected event ids now.
Sam (Finance): Please provide CSV with columns: event_id, customer_id, tokens_count, original_event_ts, duplicate_count, invoice_line_item. Also include the one-line revrec justification: 'Provisional credit issued due to duplicate metering events caused by migration webhook replay; credit to be finalized after reconciliation.'
Jordan (Support): @Lucy we'll keep the provisional credit active while finance reconciles. You should see the -$4,120 provisional on your account; final statement will reflect adjustments after our check.
Lucy (Acme Prod): Thanks everyone — please cc billing@acmehealth on the final reconciliation. Appreciate the fast turnaround.
Sam (Finance): Received. I'll hold final posting until we validate the CSV and confirm the backfill drop. Will add revrec note to the month-end journal if confirmed.
Jordan (Support): Closing loop here once Sam posts. Ticket B-8392 will have the export and patch notes attached. :thumbsup:
